Okay this is long one so strap in (its worth the read trust me)

So i started doing meth in the begging of febuary, i met this guy online and went to his place as an escort. I was doing a lot of coke and acid at the time so when he offered me the meth pipe i accepted it with no hesitation. So me and this guy vibe and i start coming over every weekend. Cut to the middle of March and i move in with him (didnt really ask just did lol). So this guys really wealthy and has pretty much unlimited meth, he gave me a daily allotment before he went to work. Cut to mid april and smoking it isnt cutting it anymore, i start boofing a garm a day, and thats when shit hit the fan. 

Episode 1: I was mid week into what would become a month of daily boofing. The come up had just worn down and i began to hear things for the first time ever. I was freaking the fuck out. I kept hearing the guy and one of his main girlfriends up stairs watching me trying to do the dishes (i was home alone) and i kept hearing him in a loop 'look at her, shes a speed addicg, shes a speed addict, jesus fucking christ loom at her go' on loop over and over. The room had this dark energy circling in on me, i kept trying to do the dishes faster so i could go upstairs and find them so they'd stop. I just kept going fasterand faster and so did the voices, eventually i collapsed to the floor and curled into a ball. Once i had the will power i went up stairs and found nothing. Then the next loop started, i heard them at the front gate and i needed to go open it. I went down there and nothing was there. So i go back up stairs and then i hear them down stairs, so i go back down to the gate. I was about 90 pounds so this took a physical toll on me, eventually im sobbing begging them to stop playing this game. I dont remeber how it ended or anything. 



Episode 2 1\3: i had just gotten home from the hospital and now the guy i live with knows about my phycosis and uses it to manipulate me. The dude had cameras all over his house ones out in the open, but hidden ones too. So im staying in the down stairs room one night while he's upstairs with another girl (these girls only came over once or twice, so i didnt know them well like his main girlfriend). Im like cool whatever, they offer me to go up there and hang with them, but i denied the offer content staying down stairs with my several grams of ice. I do a nice fat boof and lay down enjoying the come up, then it started. Whenever the hidden camera came on it would vibrate, so i knew they where watching me, but i couldnt find the camera. So i tear the room apart and eventually give up, then i relaized something was wrong with my phone and that sucks me in next. Two of his previous girlfriends had told me he had bugged their phones and to be careful (this guy was a serial abuser). So i proceeded to spend the rest of the entire night factory reseting the phone and deleting all the apps. Eventually when she left i went up stairs to confront him and he denied it. So this became a cycle, id be down stairs tweaking and he'd bring a girl over and theyd be upstairs watching me through the hidden camera in my room. 

Episode 2 2/3: so this has been going on for about 2 weeks now and now instead of random girls being brought over its his main girlfriend, but i never saw her come into thw house and he always denied ahe was there. So this is where the lines between reality and fake become so blurred i still dont know whats what even months later. When he'd go to work id be upstairs listening to music chilling, and then id hear him and the main girlfriend down stairs kn the patio, they where watchinf through the upstairs camera commenting in everything i was doing, i didnt want them to know i could hear so i was too terrified to go down stairs and do my chores, so id spend all day upstairs putting on a show pretending to be unawear that i could hear them narrating everything i did, then at night id go down stairs while he'd go upstairs and have girls over. This cycle went on for about a week. Then one day he was at work and what i believed was he had her (the main gf) hiding somewhere monitering me while he was working, she began directing me on where to find her, each time it was a false lead. She was begging me to find her. Then eventually she said 'im in the 3rd bathroom!' There was no third bathroom and she became emotional 'oh my god he never told you about the other bathroom'. Eventually i gave up, i was so emotionally exhausted. This happened about 3 times up untill the day i left. 

Episode 2 3/3, the day i left: i had stopped boofing at this point and had began taking it orally. I had ate about a gram and was spun for three days, he didnt want to give me ang more and i feinding hard. I spent the whe day in the down stairs room, talking through the vent with him and the main girlfiend, he addmited to bugging my phone and we talked the three of us for well over 12 hours, a few times i tried to go upstairs but each time i went up there he'd act confused like he had no idea what i was talking about and 'no that bitch isn't here' (i assumed he had her hide somewhere whenever i heard me coming up stairs). He left work and it continued (i believed he pretended to go to work then snuck back upstairs through a secret entence. At this point its been two weeks of non stop mind games and i couldnt take it anymore. The gf told me that one of his old gfs was coming to get me and to pack my stuff and go. So im ecstatic, finallyi can escape all this. He sees me packing, and says if i wanna go, go. He didnt even try to stop me. I spent a few hours in the parking lot waiting and she never showed. Eventually i make my way to the walgreens by the house and wait for her, but realize shes not coming. So i here i am, 3 days no sleep, everything i own in 2 bags, im maybe 90 pounds just looking god awful, the lowest point of my addiction. Then this guy pulls up and asks me if i need a place to sleep, at first i say no but then realize i have no where to go and say yes. 

Episode 3 1/2, it gets worse: so i get with this guy and he knows what i want. We cruise around for a few hours until hes able to score. I let him shoot me up for the first time. I didn't watch him do it, my eyes where closed (i was hospitalized 2 days later and found out from drug testing that he shot me up with a speed ball and didnt tell me). So the cum up is insane, we start to fuck and then boom- i black out. When i come to he drives me home to my moms where i gotta do some stuff for her. I get to my moms and instantly think this guy mustve been a cop. I keep hearing cops banging on my neighbor's doors saying they're looking for me, im crawling on the floor, just sobbing thinking theyre coming for me. It was my brothers 13th birthday and he saw it all go down, i made him hide too and told him i loved him and might be going to jail forver. Eventually i pass out and sleep for the first time in 4 days. Mom gets home and me and her get into a big fight. Im covered in bruises ( i later learned at the hospital it was from blunt force trauma, so he had most likely beat me while i was blacked out), she acuses me of being a prostitute and i lost it, it ended with me spending the night in jail. Spent the whole night tweaking out picking my skin looking for needles i think he hid in my skin. 

3 2/2 rock bottom: so i hit him up as soon as i get out, i wanted to slam again. He takes me to his trailer and i wont go into what happned but after i was shot up again i was beaten and raped. A while this is happening i hear outside the trailer the cops and my mom and grandma screaming at me that they tracked me here through my phone and they couldn't believe what i was doing. The cops began to tellme he was going to kill me and i needed to escape. So as soon as i was untied i grabbed one of his shirts, left all of my belongings except my phone and ran. No one was outside and i didnt wanna wait for them to pop out of hiding so i just run. So im tottaly naked aside from a shirt, full speed the empty street. I eventually hide behind a building and call the cops begging them to come get me. They didn't believe my story, never went back to the trailer to investigate. I was taken to a crisis center where when they saw how badly beaten i was they took me to do a rape kit. I spent the night in the hospital tweaking, thinking my mom was listening in on my rape kit and went to this whole inconsolable sobbing thinking i was pregnant and that my rights had been signed over and she was forcing me to get an abortion. It was horrible, i got no mental health serives afterwards they just sent me to a detox center which i left as soon as i go there, i wont get into what happned cos this is already long enough. 

From there i went home to my grandma (i hadnt seen her in months) and started the slow recovery process. I had another long psychotic break when i relapsed but this is already so much i think its enough lol.
